findings.issue: 一週間 is read with gemination: いっしゅうかん, not いちしゅうかん. Romaji needs the same fix (isshuukan, not ichishuukan).
findings.current: なつやすみまであとわずかいちしゅうかんだ。
findings.suggested: なつやすみまであとわずかいっしゅうかんだ。

findings.issue: In 一週間 the numeral 一 assimilates to いっ before 週間; reading いち is wrong in this context.
何 before the object particle を is read なに (なにを); なんを is nonstandard. Romaji needs the same fix (nani o..., currently 'nano...').
findings.current: なんをたべたらいいですか。
findings.suggested: なにをたべたらいいですか。

findings.issue: 何 directly before を is read なに, not なん (なん only appears before だ/で/と/の and counters).
思い通り undergoes rendaku: おもいどおり, not おもいとおり. Romaji needs the same fix (omoidoori).
findings.current: なにごともおもいとおりにするわけにわいかない。
findings.suggested: なにごともおもいどおりにするわけにわいかない。

findings.issue: In the compound 思い通り the reading of 通り voices to どおり (rendaku); standalone とおり is wrong in this context.
何時に here is なんじに ('at what time'); いつに is unnatural Japanese and contradicts the record's own pt/lit/expl ('a que horas', 'what time'). Romaji needs the same fix (nanji ni).
findings.current: いつにかえってくるの。
findings.suggested: なんじにかえってくるの。

findings.issue: 何時 followed by time-point に is read なんじ in this sentence, as the token's own gloss 'what time / que horas' shows.
expl_en/expl_pt explicitly identify the word as 何時 (なんじ) 'what time' + ごろ, and en/pt say 'about what time / que horas'; kana いつごろ contradicts the record. Romaji needs the same fix (nanjigoro).
Gloss is 'around what time / por volta de que horas', so the reading is なんじごろ; いつごろ would mean 'around when' and contradicts the explanation's explicit なんじ.
Record translates 何時 as 'what time / para que horas' and expl says 'for what time', so the reading is なんじに; いつに contradicts the rest of the record. Romaji needs the same fix.
findings.suggested: なんじにしましょうか。

findings.issue: Token glossed 'what time / que horas' must be read なんじ; いつ would be 'when' and mismatches en/pt/expl.
pt ('A que horas eu devo vir?'), lit_en ('At what time should I come') and expl all read 何時 as 'what time', so kana must be なんじに; いつに contradicts the record. Romaji needs the same fix.
findings.suggested: なんじにきましょうか。

findings.issue: Token glossed 'what time / que horas' must be read なんじ, matching the record's translations and explanation.
Internal authoring note leaked into the learner-facing explanation: 'The target is coverage, but...' is corpus-build metadata, meaningless and confusing for learners.
findings.current: The target is coverage, but the core structure is the past-habit construction with ものです.
findings.suggested: (delete this sentence; end at '...which is the central point of the sentence.')

findings.issue: Same leaked internal note in the pt-BR version: 'O alvo é cobertura...' is corpus-build metadata that should not appear in a learner explanation.
findings.current: O alvo é cobertura, mas a estrutura nuclear é a construção de hábito passado com ものです.
findings.suggested: (remover esta frase; terminar em '...que é o ponto central da frase.')

findings.issue: Under-translation: 'What time?' drops the verb and the ましょうか offer that the record's own explanation calls the target pattern; pt and lit_en both render 'should I come'.
'ir nadar muito' misplaces よく: it reads as 'swim a lot' (intensity) rather than 'often went'. Sibling sentence 187243 correctly folds よく into 'costumava'.
findings.current: No verão, eu costumava ir nadar muito naquele rio.
findings.suggested: No verão, eu costumava ir nadar naquele rio.

findings.issue: Exclamative structure ('How soon...is over') punctuated as a declarative with a period; unnatural English for a plain statement that summer vacation ends quickly.
findings.current: How soon the summer holiday is over.
findings.suggested: Summer vacation just ends so quickly.
